summary: Full backend + frontend testing of VARA luxury affiliate eCommerce app. All 11 pytest backend tests pass (products list/filter, slug lookup, related products, categories, newsletter idempotency, contact submission). Frontend flows verified end-to-end: home hero + featured/bestsellers render, header search returns results and navigates to product page, product detail (gallery thumbs, qty +/-, variant selection, Acquire triggers window.open to affiliate URL, specs accordion, detail wishlist add updates header count), shop page category filter (16→3 objects for Watches) and price sort (ascending 150→1580 verified), wishlist page reflects saved products from detail add, contact form submits, newsletter footer submits, About CTA navigates to /shop. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Product image mapping uses generic lifestyle Unsplash IDs (e.g., IMG['l1'] shows sneakers) as secondary/tertiary product images for a watch — consider swapping to category-relevant images for the Meridian/Solenne/etc. detail galleries.
Backend uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to lifespan handlers for future FastAPI versions.
Newsletter/contact endpoints have no email validation (accept any string). Consider Pydantic EmailStr.
Home.js Featured section only renders if featured.length > 0 and hardcodes 4-item grid — if API returns fewer than 4 featured products (currently returns 5), slots [4+] are ignored (minor).
seed_data_creation: 16 products auto-seeded on backend startup (verified). Test data prefixed TEST_ in newsletter/contact collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 backend endpoints and all 8 requested frontend flows passing. Product slug for detailed tests: meridian-chronograph. Sort select values are: curated|price_asc|price_desc|rating (not price-asc). Acquire button correctly calls window.open with https://partner.vara-atelier.com/shop/<slug> (external URL will not resolve — expected). Wishlist uses localStorage via WishlistContext.
